FLOW_MOD rewrites the rules, which is why an attacker who can send it controls the switch's traffic.
PACKET_IN asks the controller what to do with an unknown packet.
It tells the switch to send a given packet out a port, which an attacker could abuse.
Each unknown packet becomes a question to the controller, so the controller drowns.
Run more than one controller and lock each one down.
Control who may change the configuration, and check what they changed.
OFPT_PORT_STATUS is an informational, asynchronous message.
